answer: Standing lapses unless 6 peers re-attest it every 13 epochs, so holding a position presupposes ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in pigment and anchor lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the bridge graph. A farm of 1382 identities would post 3146 proofs and burn roughly 58 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
